flag: n=3 female test speakers — selectivity is within-sample, not a population claim
three_women_caveat: This control removes the low-rank / generic-12-person-contrast confound ONLY. It does NOT remove the three-women confound: a positive result means the whitened direction is reproducible in a way an arbitrary split of THESE 12 people is not -- it does not mean the direction generalizes beyond these three women.
design_note: enumerated all C(12,3)-1=219 non-sex 3-vs-9 partitions (exact null) rather than a 500-draw Monte Carlo of the same 220-point discrete space
